notes.title: Version 1.14
notes.content:
● Adjusted props synthetic formula:
■ Gift and bolster are the compulsory items for props synthetic.
■ Luxury gifts and humble gifts will be selected during props synthetic progress.
■ Each costume has its own synthetic formula now, instead of random formula.
■ If you synthesizing a costume that you already have, then it will be synthesized as another props.

● Remade the tutorial system. Now you can choose different module to get the tutorial you need.
● Tooltips were added on bookmark and schedule in schedule interface.
● Locke's phone number is a default item in the new game with a gift.
● Adjusted props synthetic interface to make the button more obvious.
● Fairy Pupil's tips were added to relevant interfaces.
● Adjusted shortcut keys of the Log system.
● Try to make the mouse icon's size could automatically fit the screen when initialing game or adjusting resolution.
● Temporarily repaired the problems of log disable and character's voice lost after data load before version 1.13.
　* Cancelled the data saving function that temporarily closed in the last version.
　* If you already suffered this problem before version 1.12, we are sorry that it may not be repaired.
● Fixed other bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.09
notes.content:
● Updated some English translation.
● Updated Ren'Py engine to 6.99.12.

* To all 64-bit Ubuntu users:
If you cannot start your game after updating Steam client recently, please make sure you update Steam client and game client to the latest version, in most cases the issue won’t occur again.
If the issue remains, it is still caused by Steam Runtime. It is most likely that your Steam client have crashed during its installation, due to the issue of Steam Runtime.
Currently there is no official solution to it, to run the game, you can:
1. Run ‘BloodCode.sh’ from game root folder, OR
2. Enter the following command in Ubuntu terminal (you’ll have to do it every time you start Steam)
LD_PRELOAD='/usr/$LIB/libstdc++.so.6 /usr/$LIB/libgcc_s.so.1 /usr/$LIB/libxcb.so.1 /usr/$LIB/libgpg-error.so' /usr/bin/steam

For other solutions, such as saving the command as a desktop shortcut, or using Steam Native Runtime, please refer to
https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/Steam/Troubleshooting#Steam_runtime_issues

If the issue remains, it is still caused by Steam Runtime. It is most likely that your Steam client have crashed during its installation, due to the issue of Steam Runtime.
